note: Stage 5, experiment 1. One data change against mpsenet_pretrained_dns (fine-tune of the MP-SENet DNS public weights): remixed items (50 % of all) get an SNR from [-10, 15] dB instead of [-5, 20]. Harness changes that do not alter training: the start weights are scored as epoch 0, best.pt / early stopping go by the mean of newnoise and hard:newlow PESQ instead of validation, and a weight average (decay 0.999) is saved next to every epoch.
